summary: Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for the creation of security interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, Respondent No. 1, as the Security Trustee, acting for the benefit of the Lenders, Respondent No. 2, and Respondent No. 3. _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ lien/ assignment etc. (as applicable) over all the assets, including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 1/ Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards Respondent Nos. 2-3 (the Lenders) under the Facility Agreement dated 12.11.2025;_ _(c) approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ lien/ assignment etc. over all the assets, including the movable and immovable assets, Project accounts, Project documents (including the transmission license) etc. of the Petitioner in favour of Respondent No. 1/ Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards Respondent Nos. 2-3 (the Lenders) under the Facility Agreement dated 12.11.2025 and for their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees and substitutes thereof in respect to the Project; and_ _(d) pass any such other relief as the Commission deems fit and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 1.12.2025, certifying that the aforesaid loan facility has been repaid in full by the Petitioner. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement, the secured obligations are secured by: e) On or prior to the date falling 8 months after the first Utilisation Date, the Borrower shall obtain the approval under Section 17(3) of the Electricity Act (i) all the right, title, interest, benefit, claims and demand whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Documents (other than leasehold rights pertaining to the Project Site, and including the TSA to the extent permitted under the TSA); (ii) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Authorizations, to the extent permitted under Applicable Law; (iv) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in all insurance contracts and Insurance Proceeds, in each case, pursuant to the terms of the Deed of Hypothecation; and do all such things to perfect the Security Interest created pursuant to the Security Documents set out in paragraphs (A) to (D) above (including the delivery to the Agent of any relevant Notices of Assignment and Consents to Assignment). - g) Subject to Legal Reservations, each of the Security Documents and the Security Interests over the assets created thereunder in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the Finance Parties shall be in full force and effect from and after the time of execution and delivery thereof. 6. The Petition was taken up for hearing on 18.2.2026 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated 18.2.2026, the Respondents were granted an opportunity to file their respective replies, and the Petitioner was directed to file the information called for vide letter dated 29.1.2026. 8. During the course of the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that vide RoP dated 18.2.2026, notice was issued and an opportunity was granted to the Respondents to file their respective replies. However, no reply has been filed by any of the Respondents to date. The learned counsel further submitted that pursuant to the directions issued vide the RoP dated 18.2.2026, the Petitioner has complied with the said directions vide affidavit dated 16.2.2026. The learned counsel accordingly prayed for appropriate directions in the matter. 10. In compliance with the RoP dated 25.3.2026, the Petitioner submitted the requisite information called for by way of an affidavit dated 6.4.2026. - (i) _the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or sub-section (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void.”_ 20. In the event of a default by the licensee regarding debt repayment, the Commission may, upon a joint application submitted by the licensee, lender, Security Trustee, and their nominee, consider granting approval for the assignment of the licence to a nominee, contingent upon the satisfactory completion of due diligence procedures. Consequently, it is imperative to obtain explicit prior approval from the Commission for the assignment of the licence to the nominee of the Security Trustee or for the transfer of any assets to them. Finally, the Petitioner must submit the financial documents and statements in accordance with the Commission's directives.
